solution_summary: Sofia Bennett remotely manipulated access-control systems using Marcus Reed's reflashed temporary admin token to exfiltrate Project ORION security specifications. She executed a packet suppression script to corrupt CCTV feeds between 23:45 and 23:55. When Dr. Adrian Vale caught her attempting to clear access logs in the Archive Reading Room at 23:50, she rendered him unconscious.

ground_truth_data.motive: Financial compensation from a corporate rival to exfiltrate Project ORION security architecture specs.
ground_truth_data.method: Remote access control manipulation, stolen admin token, CCTV suppression script.
